comparison.objective: Turn over an empty taped carton, cut its bottom tape, open all bottom flaps and flatten it; candidate removes loaded open cartons from a running belt.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-carton turnover, guarded cutting, outward flap articulation and intact collapse versus synchronized sidewall pinch, flap avoidance, level transport and guarded release.
comparison.success_condition: Requires complete three-path cutting, all bottom flaps opened at least 150°, then all cardboard flattened within a 24 mm slab for 1 s; candidate grades spill-free belt clearance, reject-tray release/dwell and no-contact passage of closed cartons.
comparison.reason: Shared carton geometry and articulated flaps are generic primitives; destructive opening and flattening test a different physical ability from preserving contents during selective conveyor removal. The draft has no task.json or validated full-task time limit, but its source versions provide sufficient distinct criteria.
